visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female main character with short brown hair and round glasses sits in a professional office setting. She wears a white collared shirt under a beige vest and a silver watch. Behind her is a beige wall with vertical stripes, a desk lamp, and a large designer handbag. Yellow captions appear at the bottom center. (2) Close-up macro imagery of skin with visible red acne lesions and dry patches is displayed as an overlay. The background remains the office setting. Captions change to describe skin sensitivity. (3) The scene shifts to a high-quality 3D animation featuring numerous translucent orange and yellow bubbles moving through a fluid medium, representing fermentation. A subtle glowing effect emanates from the center. (4) A product shot of a white tube labeled 'DRX Calm Relief' appears on the right side of the screen while the doctor continues to gesture with her hands in the background. The lighting is bright and even. (5) Stylized circular icons representing chemical ingredients like 'B5' and 'Bisabolol' appear alongside botanical illustrations of white flowers. The icons have a soft glow and are positioned around the doctor's gestures. (6) A brief cutaway shows a close-up of hands wearing green gardening gloves using pruning shears to trim purple and green plants in an outdoor garden with natural daylight. (7) The camera returns to the eye-level medium shot of the doctor at her desk, gesturing with one hand while holding a white object. The background remains consistent with the striped wall and handbag. (8) The video concludes with a clean white screen featuring the 'DRX Series Skincare' logo in black, centered horizontally and vertically with stylized grey diagonal lines in the background.
